stances.quote: Rep. Earl L. “Buddy” Carter (R-GA) today secured $346.1 million for Georgia’s First Congressional District in the House-passed National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)
stances.reasoning: The statement explicitly highlights securing substantial funding in the NDAA defense bill, indicating support for increased military spending.

stances.quote: As a Member of Congress, I have voted to cut more than $5 trillion in waste from the federal budget which reaches balance and begins paying off the national debt within ten years without raising taxes.
stances.reasoning: The explicit commitment to balancing the budget without raising taxes aligns with a position favoring lower taxes.

stances.quote: I will continue to fight to end Washington’s out of control spending addiction.
stances.reasoning: The direct call to end out-of-control spending and cut trillions in waste demonstrates a stance for reduced government spending.
